7414: RV park on US-180 west of Breckenridge, near Hubbard Creek Lake: over 35 back-in and pull-through sites, the premium ones on a hilltop with a view of the lake, with 30/50-amp hookups, Wi-Fi, a fire pit and a picnic table, plus 10 tent sites.  It has bathrooms and showers, a free laundry, a dump station, a store open daily, a community room and kitchen, a dog park, boat storage, and a fishing dock with kayaks. --Claude
7473: Locally owned RV park at 414 W Winburn Street, Stamford, off the US-277 frontage road, for travelers, work crews and full-timers alike: pull-through sites with 30/50-amp hookups, water, sewer, cable and Wi-Fi, all included in the rate.  There is a laundry, two shower facilities and a playground; guests pick an open site and check themselves in at the office. --Claude
7475: RV park at 11839 FM 3270 on the north side of Tyler, just off I-20, with a host on site: 20 lots with 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs among them, the eight numbered 13 to 20 beside a creek.  It has new showers, bathrooms and a laundry, open 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., and free Wi-Fi, but campfires aren't allowed.  The park also rents out a trailer by the night, and sells campers rent-to-own on condition they stay at the park until paid off. --Claude
7486: In-town RV park at 902 North Swenson Street, Stamford: large 30/50-amp full-hookup spaces on concrete patios, free Wi-Fi, a laundry and tent spaces, plus a cabin and a trailer for rent. --Claude
7558: Community of 38 RVs at 10364 County Road 740, Princeton, on a quiet peninsula about a hundred yards from Lake Lavon, with a waitlist for its lots but taking daily visitors too: wide, level pads 55 or 65 ft long with 20/30/50-amp full hookups and parking for two vehicles.  There is an on-site laundry and Wi-Fi, and a beach, fishing and boat ramps are a short walk or drive away; the park runs a background check on its guests, and RVs over 15 years old need its approval. --Claude
7571: Motel with RV sites at 127 Loop 467 East, Sonora, off I-10: full- and partial-hookup pull-through sites with 30- or 50-amp electric, by the night, week or month; campfires aren't allowed. --Claude
7600: Gated park at 2433 Duncan Drive, Freeport, built for plant contractors and other long-term tenants but also taking guests by the day or week: every site has a concrete pad and 20/30/50-amp full hookups, and rigs must be self-contained.  Showers and a laundry are open around the clock, there is a dump station and free Wi-Fi, and a restaurant and a convenience store are a short walk away; Surfside and Quintana beaches are minutes off. --Claude
7617: Family-owned park on 36 heavily treed acres on the north side of Lake Ray Roberts, at 3100 E FM 922, Valley View, bordering Corps of Engineers land: back-in and pull-through sites up to 60 ft with 20/30/50-amp full hookups and wired internet.  A community center has restrooms, showers and a 24-hour laundry, and there is a general store, a dump station, a playground, a dog park and walking trails; open fires aren't allowed, and RVs over ten years old need the management's approval. --Claude
7707: RV park opened in 2022 on 6 wooded acres with a pond, at 14649 US-59 South, 8.5 miles south of I-20's exit 617 at Marshall and 2 miles north of the Sabine River: 14 back-in and pull-through sites with 20/30/50-amp full hookups, picnic tables and fire rings.  There's no bathhouse, so RVs must be self-contained; check-in is mostly online, and the owners live a third of a mile away. --Claude
7744: RV park by the Nueces River at 410 Paisano Drive, George West, under giant live oaks: large shaded full-hookup lots, all with 50-amp service only (30-amp rigs need an adapter), and tent sites by the river on weekends.  It has a lit fishing pier with access for boating and kayaking, a pavilion and fire pit, a laundry and free Wi-Fi; the Nueces River Paddling Trail starts just upstream. --Claude
7765: RV park at 450 Old Dutchman Road, Smith Point, on Galveston Bay, with a boat ramp and dock and bank fishing: 37 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites for rigs up to 40 ft, pull-throughs among them.  There are air-conditioned bathrooms and showers and a laundry, ice is sold, and shade is limited; the gate closes at 7 p.m., so a later arrival must be arranged. --Claude
7799: RV park at 809 Highway 207, Silverton, between Amarillo and Lubbock, near Caprock Canyons and Palo Duro Canyon state parks: 30 extra-long pull-through sites with 30- or 50-amp full hookups, 5 primitive campsites and furnished cabins.  There's a bathhouse with showers, a laundry, a dump station, free Wi-Fi, a playground and an on-site food truck, The Briscoe Bite; long-term guests can get mail service. --Claude
7806: RV park opened in 2019 at 664 N US-287, just outside Elkhart and five miles from Palestine, under tall shade trees: 52 large, level back-in and pull-through sites with 30/50-amp full hookups and fast Wi-Fi.  There are two bathhouses, a coin laundry, a dump station, a fenced dog park, a catch-and-release fishing pond, nature trails and community fire pits; RVs must be self-contained, and those 12 years or older need the management's approval. --Claude
7852: RV park and cabins at 6300 State Highway 21 East, Hemphill, near Toledo Bend Reservoir and Pendleton Park: full-hookup 30- and 50-amp sites, pull-throughs among them, with free Wi-Fi and satellite TV, and seven cabins.  It has its own boat launch with low-water lake access and covered boat slips, plus showers, restrooms and a laundromat. --Claude
